text:
oscar_support: incoming P1 from Nimbus Health — onboarding stuck at provisioning after SSO flow, trial expiration tomorrow. Customer reporting `403` during token exchange. escalating to CS, please triage ASAP :rotating_light:

jules_csm: thanks oscar. looping @emma_cs_ops and @dave_se. quick ask: do we have a safe emergency path to keep them in trial while we fix SSO?

oscar_support: i created ticket `SUP-7001`. stack trace shows `403 forbidden: service-account-mapping-mismatch`. i temporarily enabled an API key for them but noted it's short-term.

emma_cs_ops: acknowledge. immediate plan options: (1) run guided admin session to rotate service account and re-upload metadata, (2) enable manual invites + extend trial, (3) if SSO provider config is wrong, escalate to infra/product.

dave_se: i can run the admin session and validate metadata. before that, need their IdP metadata file and current entityID + ACS URL. if we rotate, we'll test in sandbox first.

jules_csm: comms plan draft: 1) email offering 90-min admin session within 6 hours and manual-invite fallback, 2) if unresolved by EOD, extend trial by 10 days, 3) escalate to Product/Infra and include token debug logs. i'll send customer-facing note after we confirm times. :memo:

oscar_support: customer is available 9:00am PT. they asked for immediate workaround while SSO is fixed.

emma_cs_ops: booked 9:00am PT slot and added calendar invite. playbook excerpt to share on call:
```
- Request IdP metadata (XML) + entityID, ACS URL
- Check service account name + roles in RBAC
- Rotate service account credentials and re-run token exchange
- Validate provisioning flow end-to-end in staging
- If fail -> enable manual invite & extend trial
```

dave_se: prepping rollback and manual-invite steps. confirming no data loss risk.

handoff-bot: CS handoff created (ID: CS-HANDOFF-1955002468) -> routed to customer-success queue.

jules_csm: assigning owners: emma = conduct admin session & collect metadata, dave = technical rollback/manual-invite, oscar = support logs & ticket updates. i'll send customer note now and CC support. update here after call. :thumbsup:
